events.title: Hi
events.summary: Hi.I'm sshulin and I'm making Soulstack. This is a card stacker, and there are maybe 9 games in the genre on Steam total. Stacklands at the top with 11k+ reviews. WitchHand and Card Cultivation pulled off their launches after it. The rest got abandoned or went free. Stacks:Space and Stacks:Jungle went free. Card Age got delisted. Most attempts haven't cleared 100 reviews. So I know what I'm walking into, and I'm taking the shot anyway because I like the genre and think there's room for a version
